page_title: IPS 0-2 EVE | Ipswich v Everton 19/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' Jack Taylor (Ipswich) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90+3' Michael Oliver has a clear sight and sees a foul from Cameron Burgess (Ipswich).

90+1' What a chance that is! Jack Taylor (Ipswich) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes high over the crossbar!
90+1' The Ipswich players are exchanging some short passes.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

90' Great solo effort by Jack Taylor (Ipswich) as he tricks his way through two defenders before firing a drive from just outside of the box towards the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper is ready and produces a stunning save.

88' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Ipswich are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
87' 5:7 – the corner kicks stats.
84' The Ipswich players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
81' Sean Dyche prepares a substitution. Iliman Ndiaye is replaced by Orel Mangala (Everton).
80' Ipswich take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
79' Liam Delap will be replaced by George Hirst (Ipswich).

78' Cameron Burgess (Ipswich) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes a whisker over the bar! What a huge opportunity! The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
78' Ipswich can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

75' Liam Delap (Ipswich) got the ball on the edge of the box and fired in a first-time shot on goal, but his effort floated well over the bar. High, wide and not at all handsome. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
73' Everton control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
71' Kieran McKenna has decided to make a change. Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich) replaces Jack Clarke.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kalvin Phillips leaves the pitch and Jack Taylor (Ipswich) comes on.

69' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Ipswich are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
68' The game is interrupted. Liam Delap (Ipswich) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
66' Great teamplay by Everton as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
63' Kieran McKenna has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Harrison Clarke (Ipswich) replacing Dara O'Shea.
63' Substitution. Wes Burns makes way for Conor Chaplin (Ipswich).
61' Everton take a short corner kick.
60' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Everton are awarded a corner kick.
59' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Leif Davis (Ipswich) took the corner.
59' Wes Burns (Ipswich) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The linesman makes the right call and Ipswich will have a corner.
57' Ipswich enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
55' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Arijanet Muric stops the ball from hitting the bottom left corner.
53' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 5:7.

52' Everton slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
49' Jack Harrison (Everton) sends a cross into the box, but Arijanet Muric comes off his line to gather the ball.
47' The Everton players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
46' Referee Michael Oliver blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+7' The end of the first half.
45+6' Ipswich are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
45+4' Ashley Young (Everton) shoots towards the middle of the net from the free kick placed on the edge of the penalty box, but the goalkeeper saves.
45+4' Kalvin Phillips (Ipswich) is penalised for holding. Michael Oliver signals a set piece. Everton have a free kick from a promising distance.

45+2' Kalvin Phillips (Ipswich) strikes the ball from the resulting free kick from the edge of the box, but his effort goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
45+1' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) tackles a bit over-zealously and Michael Oliver blows for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Ipswich.
45' We will have 6 min. of added time.
43' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Ipswich.
40' 0 - 2 Fantastic team goal! Michael Keane (Everton) was set free in the area by Dwight McNeil and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the top left corner. 0:2.
40' Everton quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
40' Jack Harrison (Everton) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Everton.
39' Wonderful movement by Ipswich. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
38' The resulting set piece from Everton is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
37' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Everton have been awarded a corner kick.
37' Ipswich have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
35' Ipswich are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
31' Ipswich seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
29' The Ipswich players are stunned as referee Michael Oliver changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
29' Celebrations by Ipswich are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.

28' Dwight McNeil (Everton) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Michael Oliver blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Penalty! A huge opportunity to score for Ipswich.
26' Ipswich failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
24' Michael Keane (Everton) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Michael Oliver had an easy-decision to make.
24' Dwight McNeil (Everton) launches a cross from the corner, but Arijanet Muric is alert to thwart the effort.

22' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) makes contact with a cross but fails to connect perfectly. His low drive heads straight towards the middle of the goal where the goalkeeper makes a decent save to deny him.
20' The Ipswich players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
17' 0 - 1 Goal! Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top right corner. It's 0:1.

17' Everton slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
16' None of the Everton players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ipswich.
14' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
13' The game is interrupted now, Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

11' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Ipswich are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
9' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Everton comes to nothing.

8' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom left corner, but Arijanet Muric pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. Everton have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
7' Neat passing move from Everton in order to create new attacking opportunities.

5' Jack Clarke (Ipswich) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
5' Ipswich seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
4' A corner kick by Everton is thwarted by the well prepared Arijanet Muric (Ipswich).

4' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The linesman points to the corner flag, Everton are going to take it.
3' The Everton players are exchanging some short passes.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Ipswich will have the kick-off.
Michael Oliver will supervise the game today.
